chapters: Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Sauul gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu duukam gu Amalekitas juruuñ gook gu tanoolh gu Siklag.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tanoolh jix duñia' suudai' u'va maa'n yooxi' gu Sauul gu takarui' jajannulhi'ñ gu oidha' bhaan mo'o; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Dabii o'lhia'n gu oidha' jix duu tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu Dabii; gio ba' duukat gu jodai' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu chuukug gio mui'x gu ja'tkam ia'rɨ koko'kam; gio ba' gio gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar jix koko'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mii' dhɨr biapma' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ñɨidhat gu Sauul jix koi gu Jonataan gu mar.
Jano' ba' biapma' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu jodai' gu kavɨk gu Gilboa gu ñi'ook gu Sauul ka't gu chuukug bhaan gu bhóogɨt aajidha' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu suudai' jix ñi' jup tɨɨt; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka gu chuukug tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Soy gu Amalekita.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' a'ga; na gu' tu' soi'ñ tu' gu chuukug bhaan tu' gu jodai' na gu' jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu'.
Na gu' tu' jano' ba' gu takarui' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' bhai'x cham gu tanoolh duaka' mi' dhɨr gu chuukug; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ kuruun ga'ra' mo'o gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu jodai' jix bhai'x gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duu gu chichio'ñ mi'p bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai gu ux gu Sauul gu ux gu Jonataan gu mar gu ux gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu vaak gu Israeel; na gu' gu suudai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mii' dhɨr biapma' ka't gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' duukat gu chuukug tu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu mar ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu Amalekita.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu chuukug choo'n jix duñia' gu novɨ na ba' kooda' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Dabii maa'n biipibop; gio ba' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr naaka'n jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o gu chin jix duñia' bhaan tu' bham; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Dabii gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar bɨɨx dhi' gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' gu suudai' ua'nak u'uan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel bhaan gɨ' kavɨk gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Gat cham jix maa jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Askaloon; na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk gu Gilboa tu' gu suudai' tu' dhuuk jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'nkar na jix maa; na gu' ka't jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu Sauul na ja'p tu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' maa'n bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu ɨ'ɨr koko'kam cham gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' tu' gu kuchii gu Sauul jix duñia' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jonataan tɨɨdam gu jodai' gu oidha' koi'm gu suudai' jix bɨɨx duu gu takarui'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Israeel jix duñia' bhaan gu Sauul gu suudai' tu jiim jix suudai' duu jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chuukug jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu Jonataan jix koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' no'ñ gu ux tu' xibhɨk gu chuukug gu Jonataan gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't xoi'kam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak jix kavɨk jix koi gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ; jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' a'ga; gio ba' duukat jix tɨ'ɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gook gu u'vɨ gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita gu Abigail ka't gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu Dabii baidhak gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx jix daa dhi' maa'n bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' jix koi jɨ'dɨlh gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa tu jiim gu Dabii gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu vaak gu Judaa; gio ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr gu Jabes gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Sauul.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii gu takarui' gu Jabes gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu Sauul jix duñia' jix maa gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r; gio ba' tu' gio gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam gu ux dhi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jano' gu noobh gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk; na gu' jix koi gu Sauul gu Jawatan gu vaak gu Judaa jix duñia' maa'n gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Sauul jix bhɨɨ gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu jodai' bhaan gu Jesreel bhaan gu Epraim bhaan gu Benjamiin bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.

Na pai' dhuuk oo'm gu takarui' ka't gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gook gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu duukam gu vaak gu Judaa gu takarui' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh gu Dabii jix gɨ'kora' gu ebroon bhaan gu vaak gu Judaa kɨɨv gu takarui' gu ux masaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner jix buus gu Maanaim gu kutun bɨɨx tu duukam gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar tu duukam gu Dabii moor jix duñia' ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu kutun; gio ba' na ja'p jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abner gu Joab; gio ba' gu Lebaantense jano' biipibop gu suudai' vupui bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu Joab jix aa'; jano' ba' gu Lebaantense.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu Benjamiin baasɨ'n gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul; gio ba' gu kutun tu duukam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' maa'n mi'x juu'ñ gu novɨ mo'o duiñchu' jix duñia' gu kuchii gu ux jano'maram gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ux ka't tɨɨgim mii' dhɨr pai' gu elkat-assurim gu kutun.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu Abner gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n tu duukam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' mi'p vaik gu ma'nkam gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu Joab gu Abisai gu Asael; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Asael ka't gu chuukug tɨɨt na ja'p gu takarui' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chɨ'ɨɨk gu Abner jiimchu' bhaan cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abner jix duñia' gu suudai'; gio ba' cham gu chuukug tu' gu Asael jix aa'; mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abner; gio ba' gu takarui' tu jiim o'nsop gu jodai' oi'ñdha' biipibop jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu' gu takarui'; gu' gu Asael cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Abner jix duñia' a'ga gu Asael; na gu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' na gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu o'o gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu vupui xibhɨk gu Joab.

Jano' ba' cham gu takarui' jix duu naaka'n gu Abner bɨɨx jix suudai' duu gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu jodai' o'o jix buus gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' jix koi mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx aajidha' gu ux mii' dhɨr pai' gu Asael ka't gu vaak ka't jix koi gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu Joab gu Abisai bhiadat gu Abner; na pai' dhuuk jix dhaas gu tas na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Amma vupui bhaan gu Giia ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu suudai' bɨɨx gu Abner gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Abner jix maa jiiñak gu Joab bham; gio ba' gu takarui' gu kuchii jix bhai'x cham ñɨidhat tu' gu maa'nkar gu takarui' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham a'ga gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook tu' dɨr dhi' gu xibh gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu chuukug gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Joab jix duñia' gu suudai' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt cham chɨ'ɨɨk gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel tu' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Abner gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ux vaak ja'tkam bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' bhɨi gu Jordaan gu tasi' gu ux bɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Maanaim.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gio jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Abner gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tu duukam gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ gu Asael.
Gu' gu' tu duukam gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Benjamiin gu Abner vaik gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ jix koko'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tukga'n gu taat gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu Joab gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' ka't gu jodai' bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Sauul gu vaak gu Dabii; gu' gu Dabii gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Sauul gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Dabii gu ebroon; gio ba' maa'nkam mar ka't gu Ammoon gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita.
Jano' ba' gook gu Kileab gu Abigail gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo; gio ba' vaik gu Absaloom gu mar gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Talmai gu gɨ'kora' gu Gessur.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu Adoniias gu mar gu aggit; gio ba' jixchamaam gu oi'ñga'n gu mar gu Abital.
Jano' ba' xijumai gu ñi'ook gu Egla gu u'vɨ gu Dabii; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Dabii gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Sauul gu Dabii ka't gu Abner jix duñia' gu ux gu vaak gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Sauul jix duñia' gu u'vɨ jup tɨɨt gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu chuukug; gio ba' jix aa' gu Is-boset gu Abner; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook kia'mi'ñ gu u'vɨ gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' bhaam gu Abner gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Is-boset; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' mo'o gagai' gu takarui' gu Judaa tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu vaak gu Sauul gu taat bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam cham tu' dhagia' gu noobh gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tasi' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug uañi'ñ dhi' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Abner gu suudai' tu' na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Sauul gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ atooxkor gu Dabii bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Abner na gu' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Abner gu takarui' gu Dabii baasɨ'n bham; gio ba' gu jodai' gu oidha' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu vupui ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu chuukug gu suudai' gu novɨ ka't bɨndak na ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' bɨx gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨndak ñi'ook na jix bhaan; na pai' dhuuk gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu chuukug cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham maa'n gu bhóogɨt gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' bhañ gu Dabii gu takarui' gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu Mikâl tu' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Is-boset bhañ jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Paltiel gu mar gu Lais.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ joi'ndam bɨɨx ka'm gu Baurim; gio ba' jix aa' gu Abner; mi' dhɨr jiim gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abner bɨɨx daraa gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook va'k jix duñia' gu Dabii jum duu gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' gu takarui'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu novɨ tu duukam gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Pilisteos gu novɨ bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Abner gu Benjamiin; gio ba' ka't gio gu Abner gu ebroon gu chuukug gu Dabii bɨx gu suudai' gu Israeel bɨx gu vaak gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Abner gu Dabii gu ebroon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duu gu takarui' gu Abner bɨɨx gu suudai' tɨbiap.

Ba' jix aa' gu Abner gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu Israeel na ba' xoi'kam bɨndak ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duu; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Abner ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu duukam gu Dabii gu Joab aajidha' yooxi' gu bhóogɨt baidhak gu ja'tkam; gu' gu Abner cham ka't bɨɨx gu Dabii gu ebroon tu' ka't jix duñia' ka't gu ja'tkam bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Joab bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Joab bham; gio ba' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner tu' tɨbiap gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duñia' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joab suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ka't tɨbiap gu Abner tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook mi'x dhaas ka't.
Jano' ba' ñɨidhat tu' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner tu' tɨbiap na ba' gu suudai' maachim gu ñi'ook ba'k gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx tu' duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Joab bɨɨx gu Dabii bhañ gu takarui' bhaan gu Abner suulh dɨr oidha' suudai' gu Sira cham maachim gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Abner jix duñia' gu ebroon jix ai'chdhix gu Joab tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx jix bhai'x naaka'n gu ux gu jodai' o'o kuiñcha koi'm gu Asael xibhɨk jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt mi' dhɨr dhi'; gio ba' na jix bhai' dhi' tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ɨ'ɨr gu Abner gu mar gu Ner.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan mo'o gu Joab bhaan bɨx gu vaak gu taat; na cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu vaak gu Joab gu ñi'ook ɨ'ra'n tu' gakiidha' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' uañi'ñ gu takarui'.
Na gu' gu Joab gu Abisai xibhɨk mu'aa gu Abner na gu' ka't jix koi gu Asael xibhɨk gu chuukug gu kutun.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Joab bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't; gio ba' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Abner; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Abner gu ebroon; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan tukga'n gu Abner; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gio bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Abner chɨtda; gio ba' jix koi gu Abner na ja'p suulhgidha' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu noobh cham mi'p gu ñi'ook tu' tɨɨt gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tomaat gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' jix xuaak bhaan.

Jano' ba' na ja'p bɨx gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu chuukug jugi gu takarui' gu Dabii gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu Dabii gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' tu' va'k jix duñia' gu tas gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu vupui; na gu' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu vupui bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu Israeel aagɨt mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham ka't tɨbiap gu gɨ'kora' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner vaak jodai.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam; gio ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.

Na tu' jano' gu suudai' jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu gɨ'kora' maa'n; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu kutun cham bhai' duñia' jurtu'nka' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu mar gu Sauul gu Abner ka't jix duñia' jix koi gu ebroon gu noobh jix duñia' ka't gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu mar gu Sauul gook gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook chu'p gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n ka't gu Baana gu Rekâb gu ma'nkam gu Rimmoon gu Beerotita gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin; na gu' gu Beerot ka't gu jodai' bɨɨx gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu Beerotitas gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Gittaim gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba'; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul ga'ra' gu mar gu takarui' tɨɨt gu bhóogɨt jixchamaam gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt koi'm gu Sauul gu Jonataan suudai' u'va gu Jesreel jix bhɨɨ jix maa jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu chuukug bɨɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x; jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Mepi-boset.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rimmoon gu Beerotita gu Rekâb gu Baana jix bɨɨx duu baap jix gɨ' jix tónom gu tanoolh gu vaak gu Is-boset ka't kookos gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' baap tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu suudai' kai'ñ jix duñia' gu jodai' o'o; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Rekâb gu Baana xibhɨk.
Na gu' na ja'p baap gu vaak kua' gu takarui' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim koox jix duñia' mo'o gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tukaa' gu ux gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' aichdhak mo'o gu Is-boset gu Dabii gu ebroon gui'p gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu suudai' mo'o gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul bhaamki'ñdha' jix duñia' kooda'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Sauul gu kai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Rekâb xibhɨk gu Baana gu ma'nkam gu Rimmoon gu Beerotita; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu chuukug.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk maa'n jix maa jix duñia' bham gu suudai' gu Sauul jix koi gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Siklag gu kutun jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n tomaat gu chichio'ñ mu'aa gu chio'ñ jir bhai' gu vaak bhaan gu suudai' jano' cham no'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr gu noobh jix duñia' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa'ñdhix biipibop gu takarui' mu'aa jix duñia' gu noobh tɨɨt jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ebroon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ mo'o gu Is-boset jix duñia' tukga'n gu Abner gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu Dabii gu ebroon tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu suudai' no'ch gu'ch o'oo gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu ñi'ook va'k na pai' dhuuk gu Sauul jix duñia' bhaan no'ch tu' jix buusñi gu bhóogɨt gu Israeel; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' ka' bhaan gu Israeel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨɨtɨs bɨx daraa gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ebroon vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu jiim gu Dabii gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' oo'm gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ebroon jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Judaa kɨɨv gu takarui' gu ux masaa'n; gio ba' gu Jerusalem jix gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook vaik gu takarui' bhaan bɨx gu Israeel gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu gu Jerusalem gu Jebuseo jix daa gu oidha'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr tu' cham ba'k jix bhai'x tu' cham mi'x juu'ñ ñiññia mama'mkulhi'; jano' ba' bham; gio ba' cham jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu Dabii.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu kavɨk gu Sioon kiicham gu Dabii.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' chɨkka jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo mama'mkulhi' ñiññia gu i'ii'ñ gu Dabii bhaamki'ñ gu ux dhi' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bai'ñchu' tu' jix bhai'x cham jix duñia' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix koi gu kavɨk jix dhaas gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Kiudad gu Dabii; gio ba' pai'x xikoolh dɨr gu ux na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro bhañ gio gu chuukug gu Dabii gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu ñi'ook tɨ'ya' na ba' gu tasi' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu jiim gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel ka't gu oi'ñga'n oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ux xoi'kam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n gu u'vɨ gu Jerusalem mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu ebroon jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Sammua gu Sobab gu Nataan gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Ibar gu Elisua gu Nepeg.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu Elisama gu Eliada gu Elipelet.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pilisteos gu suudai' maa'n gu Dabii gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel bɨx gu Pilisteos jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' na ja'p gu Dabii jix kai suudai' u'va gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu jiim bhaan gu Pilisteos kapbhai' gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Dabii; na gu' tu' na gu' gu ñi'ook kapbhai' gu Pilisteos gu noobh.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Dabii gu Baal-perasim jix duñia' gu Dabii; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios obhɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu ux dhi' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Baal-perasim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook duiñxim jix duñia' gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu kutun jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' cham jix tɨ'ɨ; gu' gu jodai' ɨlhdham gu ux vupui bhaan jix koi.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ux jaja' jix koi jano' ba' tu' gu takarui'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' naaka'n gu Pilisteos dɨr gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii ka't bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak gu Baal gu Judaa na ba' gu chuukug kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ka't gu suudai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu duukam jix vɨɨk bhɨɨk gu vaak gu Abinadab ka't gu chuukug; gio ba' gu Ussa gu Aio gu ma'nkam gu Abinadab jix duñia' gu duukam jix vɨɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu vaak gu ñi'ook ka't gu chuukug bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aio gu chuukug vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu u'u ka't; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu suudai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' ka't gu Nakôn gu Ussa jix duñia' gu novɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; na gu' gu vaakax jix duñia' xiixkai.
Jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tai bhaan gu Ussa naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios gu ux mii' dhɨr jix duñia' jix koi ju'ñdharan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu ux gu suudai' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Ussa; gio ba' ka't tɨɨgim mii' dhɨr pai' gu Peeres-ussa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix ai tu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios kiicham gu Dabii; gu' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' juruuñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu chuukug vaik masaa'n; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Obed-edom bɨx gu vaak.

Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' gu vaak gu Obed-edom bɨx juraa'n kuiñcha kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't jix bhɨɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom kiicham gu Dabii bɨɨx gu kutun.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ux tu jiim gu vaak na jix bhai' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ga'ra' tɨi'chu' gu Dabii gu suudai' gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu jodai' gu suudai' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' na ja'p kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' kiicham gu Dabii ka't gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul tu jiim dɨr gu ñi'ook jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas pai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel gu Dabii ka't gu chuukug; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Dabii maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ maa'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu takarui' suudai' u'va; gio ba' ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii na ba' jix bhai' aa' gu vaak; gio ba' gamai' gu Mikâl gu takarui' gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' nɨidhat tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel cham kutun gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu suudai' tu duukam na ja'p cham kutun gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Mikâl; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n xoi'kam gu taat bɨx gu vaak jix aa'ñdhix jum duu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n dhi' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu vupui; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu suudai' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix duñia' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm.
Jano' ba' ka't kua' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Nataan; gio ba' gu suudai' jano' tu' jix koi gu takarui' gɨ' u'u kavɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nataan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jiim gu vupui bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Nataan bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak tu' jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu chuukug gu vaak dɨr gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu suudai' vaak zel vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu Israeel ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel na ba' a'ga; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gɨ' u'u kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jano' daipu' tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' kakneer na ba' gu suudai' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨndak bɨx gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tu' gu takarui' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' jix gɨ' na ja'p gu tɨɨgɨ' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook pai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' gu ux na tu ibai' na ba' jix duñia' pai' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p va'k.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' duñia' maachim tu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu vaak.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' bɨɨx tattat tu' dhi' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' gu takarui' ba'k gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' bɨɨx tas atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu taat ka't tu' gu mar; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai' tu' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ux gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch cham gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu chuukug gu Sauul gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu takarui' gu vaak oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' atooxkor ka't dhi' jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Nataan gu Dabii.
Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka jix duñia' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' dhi' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gio tu ñi'ook gu vaak tu duukam gu ux gu kutun; gio ba' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii a'gi'ñchu' bɨndak tu' jix maati' tu duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' gu tasi' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' maachim tu duukam.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios mai' tu' jurtu'nka' bɨx gu jodai' naak bɨɨx naak maatɨt.

Jano' ba' chɨkka na ja'p gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu Israeel gu oidha' gu ja'tkam gu ux xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios jum duu gu suudai' gu ux gu ja'tkam jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu jodai' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ buimɨi gu oidha' gu ux xoi'kam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ejipto chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu jiim gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu ux gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bhaan tu duukam bhaan gu vaak gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas gu vupui jurtu'nka'.
Na ka't gu suudai' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas gu chuukug; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu vaak tu duukam gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu suudai' naak tu duukam bham; gio ba' gu Yo tu' gu suudai' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr gu ux dhi' tu duukam tu' gaagam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' a'ga vupui bhaan tu' dhi' ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't jiimda' tu' tu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx jano' xoi'kam gu jodai' gu vaak tu duukam na ba' jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix bhai' aa' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu vaak tu duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Dabii naaka'n gu Pilisteos jix duñia'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu Metegamma gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gio gu Moab jix duñia' bɨɨx gu duukam gu jodai' mi'x juu'ñ gu ux gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gook gu takarui' na ba' koi'm gu duukam gu takarui' na ba' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu Moabitas tu duukam bɨtaa'n namki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' naaka'n gu Dabii gu adad-eser gu mar gu Reob gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba jiimchu' jix duñia' gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii jix bhai'x gu chuukug kavaayo gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook mi'x dhaas.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ñi'ook gu Damasko gu chuukug u'ua'tɨdham gu adad-eser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba; gio ba' gu Dabii naaka'n gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Dabii gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Damasko jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Dabii gu suudai' namki'ñdha'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios nukadham gu Dabii pai' gu bhóogɨt ka't.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt tu duukam gu adad-eser jix duñia' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Beta gu Beerot jɨ'dɨlh gu adad-eser jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu vaak gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Toi gu gɨ'kora' gu amat gu Dabii ka't gu jodai' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu adad-eser.

Na gu' bhañ gu Toi gu Joram gu mar gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii tulhiiñdha' jix bhai'x jix bhai' aa' na gu' ka't gu jodai' bɨɨx gu adad-eser ka't gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Toi ka't bhaamki'ñdha' gu adad-eser; mi' dhɨr gu Joram jix duñia' gu novɨ gu ux jix toja jodai gu ux jix uam jodai gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai ga'ra' gu takarui' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moabitas gu Ammonitas gu Pilisteos gu Amalekitas gu takarui' gu adad-eser gu mar gu Reob gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook naaka'n mambhɨɨx gu tasi' jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu takarui' gu Edom gu ux bɨx gu Edom jix dhaas gu takarui'; gio ba' bɨx gu chuukug jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios nukadham gu Dabii gu ux pai' gu bhóogɨt ka't.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Josapat gu mar gu Ailud gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Sadok gu mar gu Aitud gu Aimelek gu mar gu Abiatar jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu Seraiia ka't gu o'o.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' ka't bhaan gu Kereteos gu Peleteos; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dabii jix duñia' chiñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' oi'ñdha' gu vaak gu Sauul gu oi'ñga'n tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jonataan.
Ba' jix aa' ka't tu duukam gu vaak gu Sauul tɨɨt gu Siba na ja'p tɨɨt gu suudai' gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu chuukug tu' gu Siba jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham tu' jix duñia' soo'mchulhdhak gu vaak gu Sauul gu oi'ñga'n tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Siba jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu mar gu Jonataan gu takarui' tɨɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu chuukug duukat gu Siba jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu vaak gu Makîr gu mar gu Amiel gu Lodebar.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu vaak gu Makîr gu mar gu Amiel gu Lodebar.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨbiap gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul gu Dabii o'lhia'n bhaan gu vupui tu jiim; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Mepi-boset; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ choo'n na gu' tu' tu'r gu bhóogɨt bɨndak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ux xoi'kam gu Jonataan gu taat tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sauul gu taat; mi' dhɨr tu' jugi bɨɨx tas gu takarui' gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu jodai'; gio ba' chɨkka tu duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook gagai' jix koi na ja'p tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jup tɨɨt gu Siba tu duukam gu Sauul; gio ba' bɨx ka't gu Sauul bɨx gu vaak tu' jix maa gu mar gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tu' tu juan oi'ñga'n tu' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam tu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'bhɨ na ba' gu mar gu Jawatan jix duñia' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai'; gio ba' gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Jawatan jugi bɨɨx tas gu takarui' gu vaak na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr ga'ra' gu Siba gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook tu duukam.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Siba gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam jix duñia' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Mepi-boset jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jugi gu vaak na jix bhai' na ja'p maa'n gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Mepi-boset gu mar jix ali' jup tɨɨt gu Mikâ; gio ba' bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu vaak gu Siba jix duñia' tu duukam gu Mepi-boset.
Na gu' jix koi gu Mepi-boset gu Jerusalem na gu' jugi bɨɨx tas gu vaak na jix bhai' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ka't jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't jix koi gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu kutun gu anuun gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu anuun gu mar gu Naas na ja'p gu taat jix duu gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr bhañ gu Dabii tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu ux gu taat; gu' gu oi'ñga'n tu duukam gu Dabii gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gui'p gu anuun gu Jawatan; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu taat tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ nuukdaidha' cham tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii tu duukam tu' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' kiicham na ba' cham tu' duu.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu anuun jix bhɨɨ tu duukam gu Dabii jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' jix duñia'.

Na gu' na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook maachim gu Dabii bhañ jix ai na gu' mi'p gu ñi'ook jum xibhɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duu gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Jerikoo bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' maaxilhia' gu chuukug jano' ba' jix suudai' duu.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii mɨjɨ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu Soba gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Maaka jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Dabii bhañ gu Joab bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu vaak gu chuukug ba'k ki'ñgob; gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Soba gu Reob gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Maaka mi'p gu ux yooxi'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Joab ka't gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu suudai' kapbhai' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel jix dhaas gu vaak bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' do'ñcho jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Abisai xibhɨk jix dhaas gu vaak na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Ammonitas.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' u'ua'tɨdham; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu suudai' u'ua'tɨdham.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu ux chulhiiñdha' gu ja'tkam gu ux jɨ'dɨlh chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Joab gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gu' jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' jiboi'ññor gio vupui bhaan gu Abisai baap kiicham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Joab gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem.
Gu' gu' ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu vaak vupui bhaan gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu adad-eser jix buusñi gu ñi'ook mi'p baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim tɨɨtɨs gu elam gu suudai' gu ux gu kutun gu Sobak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu adad-eser.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel bhɨi gu Jordaan suudai' u'va gu elam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu vaak bhaan gu Dabii gu ux bɨɨx.

Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' naaka'n gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu ñi'ook oo'm jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ kavaayo; mi' dhɨr naaka'n gio gu Sobak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix koi.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu adad-eser na ja'p gu suudai' jix duñia' gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Israeel jix duu bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Israeel jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Dabii bhañ gu Joab tu duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Ammonitas jix dhaas jix duñia' gu Rabba; gu' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jerusalem.

Na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' kɨkbo gu Dabii gu suudai' gu tas gu xumai jix duñia' gu ux gu tasi' gu vaak vaak ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' dɨr gu tasi' gu u'vɨ ka't jix duñia' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii tu ñi'ook gu ux mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gui'p; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu Bat-seba mar u'vɨ gu Eliam gu u'vɨ gu Uriia gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' ka't kia'mi'ñ jix koox bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu vaak jix duñia' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu u'vɨ bhañ gu chuukug maachim gu Dabii bham; gio ba' tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii bhañ gu chuukug gu Joab; gio ba' gu jodai' gu Uriia gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr bhañ gu Joab gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Uriia suudai' u'va tɨtda:―¿Jax gu Dabii gu ux tulhiiñdha' gu Joab gu ux tulhiiñdha' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Dabii gu Uriia; gio ba' gu chuukug gu vaak jix duñia' tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr gamai' gu Uriia gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' suudai' u'va bhaan jugi vaak ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' gu Uriia jix koox ki'ñgob gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx bɨx tu duukam gu Jawatan cham jix dhaav gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu maachim dhi' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Uriia cham tu' jix duñia' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Dabii gu Uriia; jano' ba' cham tɨbiap gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook cham gu suudai' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu Uriia jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Judaa bɨtaa'n vaak zel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu Joab tu duukam gu Jawatan bhaan gu vupui yooxi'; jano' ba' ka't tu' baakɨi gu vaak na ba' jugi i'i koox bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu ux gu oidha' gu suudai' gu ux gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ tu' cham gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Uriia; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu xibh tu' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Uriia gu Jerusalem mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh buimgidhak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii jix duñia' jugi i'i vupui bhaan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix buus gu xumai koox gu suudai' bɨɨx tu duukam gu Jawatan; gu' cham jix dhaav gu vaak.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xibh ua'na gu Dabii gu Joab gu ñi'ook bhañ gu ux gu novɨ gu Uriia.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Uriia vupui bhaan gu kavɨk gu chuukug gu jodai' na ba' ka't gu jodai'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Joab jix duñia' kiicham jix dhaas gu Uriia pai' bhai'x mi'p gu chichio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gamai' kiicham gu ux bɨɨx gu Joab ia'rɨ dhɨt gu ja'tkam tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' jix koi gio gu Uriia gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' bhañ gu Joab maachim gu Dabii bɨx gu takarui' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix mattuda' bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu takarui' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' jugi gu bhóogɨt tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu ux cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' chɨkka naaka'n gu Abimelek gu mar gu Jerobaal cham jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Tebes gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' daipu'; mi' dhɨr gio tu duukam gu Uriia gu takarui' jix koi.
Jano' ba' ka't mattuda' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu Dabii bɨx tu'x gu Joab ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' mattuda' gu Dabii; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ moor no'ch yooxi' xoi'kam no'ch gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm ba'k ki'ñgob.
Gu' gu' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bhaan tu duukam dɨr gu ñi'ook jix koko' dhɨt tu duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix koi gio tu duukam gu Uriia gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mattuda'; gio ba' daipu' gu Joab; mi' dhɨr cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu dhi' gu jodai' nɨidhim gu takarui' gu kuchii; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu chuukug bhaan kiicham bɨɨx ka'm gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu tɨiñ gu u'vɨ gu Uriia gu chio'ñ gu Uriia ka't jix koi gu ñi'ook gu ux gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug bhañ gu Dabii jix duñia' gu vaak; gio ba' ka't gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu mar; gu' dhi' gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook ka't jix bhai'x gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios gu Nataan gu Dabii bai'ñpu'; gio ba' ka't gook gu chichio'ñ kiicham maa'n gu chuukug gampai'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug ga'ra' gu oi'ñga'n kakneer gu jodai'.
Gu' gu' gampai' cham ga'ra' gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam ali' karneer ka't jugi jix duñia' ka't gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ma'nkam bɨɨma'n jugi gu chin i'i vaaso kookos baaso; gio ba' ga'ra' na ja'p mar u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va maa'n gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ gu chuukug; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ kakneer gu jodai' na ba' gu ñi'ook ka't tɨbiap gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ kaneer mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gampai' jix duñia' na ba' gu bhóogɨt ka't tɨbiap.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tai i'iich gu Dabii bhaan mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Nataan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix duu suuska'n koi'm.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook ali' karneer bɨɨx maakobh gu bhóogɨt na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Nataan gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu Yo tu' maa'n gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel tu' gu takarui' gu novɨ gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaak gu Jawatan gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan baaso; gio ba' gu jodai' dhi' tu' gu vaak gu Israeel gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' gu vaak tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' tu'x.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios duñia' cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Uriia gu takarui' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu ux jano' cham gu ñi'ook mɨɨjidha' gu vaak gu kuchii; na gu' gu jodai' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu Uriia gu takarui' na ba' jum duu gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan tu' cham bhai' gu vaak jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ vupui bhaan gu vupui gu suudai' tɨtmo gu takarui' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ ñiata dhi' gu tas.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n ɨxchuixim; gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt dhi' vupui bhaan bɨx gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu tas.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Nataan; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Nataan jix aa' gu Dabii; jano' ba' gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' uañi'ñ; gio ba' cham koi.
Na gu' gu' na gu' bɨɨx dhi' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu mar tu' maaxir koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Nataan jix duñia' gu vaak; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu Uriia ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii jix duñia' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu Dabii jix duñia' gu tukaa' jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo daraa gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu na ba' jix duñia' jix búup gu oidha'; gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix jugi bɨɨx gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix koi gu ñi'ook; gu' tu duukam cham gu suudai' duñia' maachim gu ñi'ook ka't jix koi bham tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu ñi'ook cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai' jix duñia' tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix koi.
Gu' gu' gu Dabii ñɨi'ñ tu duukam ñiokda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't jix koi; gio ba' gu ux jix aa' gu Dabii tu duukam; mi' dhɨr jix koi gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix koi.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix búup gu oidha' jix duñia' tu jiim jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n chɨbiapui gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu vaak jix duñia' jix dhaas gu takarui' jix jugi.
Jano' ba' gui'p tu duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix koi gu suudai' jugi gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' na jix do'ig gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu maa'nkar tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n jugi tu' gu ux gu tai gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' jano' tu' jix koi na ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Bat-seba gu u'vɨ baakɨk jix koox bɨɨx; gio ba' jix duñia' gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Salomoon jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na bhañ gu ux gu novɨ gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jedidia kuiñcha gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu ux bhaan gu Rabba gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix bhɨɨ kiicham vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu Joab gu takarui' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' bhaan gu Rabba jix bhɨɨ kiicham gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu kutun jano' gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu takarui' yooxi' bhaan kiicham gu ñi'ook; na gu' dhaagɨk tu' kiicham cham jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Dabii bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bhaan gu Rabba jugi jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ kuruun gu gɨ'kora' mo'o gu ñi'ook gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix uam jodai ga'ra' gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' bhaan mo'o gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu takarui' kiicham.

Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu suudai' gu ja'tkam ka't jix dhaas bɨtaa'n gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' jix kavɨk jodai gu chuukug jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu ux gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr jix duu bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' da'p gu Absalom gu mar gu Dabii gu ja'tkam gu takarui' jup tɨɨt gu Tamar jix duñia' gu Amnoon gu mar gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Amnoon jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu takarui' gu ux gu Tamar gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu ux gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Amnoon gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Amnoon ga'ra' gu ja'tkam jup tɨɨt gu Jonadab gu mar gu Simea xibhɨk gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't gu Jonadab gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix maat.
Ba' jix aa' gu ux; gio ba' gu mar gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug cham gu bhóogɨt tu' gu Amnoon jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu takarui' gu Tamar gu ja'tkam gu Absalom xibhɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonadab; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' ka'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu taat gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu takarui'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu Tamar na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jugi gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu kutun na ba' ñɨi'ñ tu' jugi gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Amnoon jix duñia' ka't ka'ook suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Amnoon gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu Tamar gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan tu' gook gu suudai' jugi tu' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii bhañ gu Tamar gu vaak bham; gio ba' tu' jano' gu vaak gu Amnoon xibhɨk tu jiim jugi.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Tamar gu vaak xibhɨk gu Amnoon ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu vaak jix duñia' jix duu gu suudai' vupui bhaan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ux jix buusñi vupui bhaan; gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n jugi; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Amnoon; jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ mai' bɨx; gio ba' bɨx moor.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Amnoon gu Tamar; gio ba' jix duñia' jugi gu jodai' na ba' tu' jugi gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr dhaagɨk gu Tamar gu suudai' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' xibhɨk gu Amnoon gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix dhaas vupui bhaan na ba' jugi jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix ai gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham xibhɨk gu chuukug cham gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk; na gu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' na gu' duukat gu chuukug tu' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p maa'n gu bhóogɨt gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' cham jix duñia' tu'.
Gu' gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' va'k gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Amnoon gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨɨx jix duñia' ka't jix gɨ' xoi'kam bɨɨx ka't dha'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Amnoon; mi' dhɨr bamii' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ' cham bhai' gu ux mi'x juu'ñ gu ñi'ook; gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' va'k tɨɨt jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ gu chuukug mai' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' bhaan gu ñi'ook jix uam jix bhɨɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ mai' jix duñia' gu vupui ki'ñgob bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Tamar jix bhɨɨ maatai jix duñia' bhaan mo'o jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix uam ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu noobh bhaan mo'o ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' xibhɨk gu Absalom; gio ba' tu' dhi' bɨndak xibhɨk gu Amnoon gu chuukug jano' gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr xibhɨk; jano' ba' cham gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ dhi' gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Tamar gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Absalom xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix kai bɨx dhi' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Absalom cham bɨɨx gu Amnoon tu' cham bhai' tu' jix bhai'; na gu' xoi'kam gu Absalom gu bhóogɨt gu Amnoon na gu' ka't gu takarui' gu Tamar gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gook gu takarui' gu Absalom ga'ra' gu oi'ñga'n gu Bala-asor ju'ñdharan gu Epraim; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Absalom bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu duukam juraa'n jano' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam bɨɨx tu duukam.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Absalom; na gu' cham gu mar gu chuukug cham gu chuukug bɨx na gu' cham tu' jix duu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu ux jix duñia' bɨɨx cham gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu' jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Absalom; gio ba' tu' cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx no'ch gu Amnoon xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Absalom gu bhóogɨt mi'x dhaas tu' bɨɨx gu Amnoon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Absalom jix maa gu vaak gu suudai' bham; gio ba' jano' xoi'kam gu suudai' duuk gu i'ii'ñ gu Amnoon jix duñia' jix bhai'x suudai' u'va tu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu Amnoon jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt cham gu takarui'; na tu' jix aa'ñdhix; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Absalom jix duu bɨɨx gu Amnoon na ja'p gu Absalom ka't jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix búup bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx gu jodai' jiboi'ññor.
Jano' ba' kua' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Dabii gu takarui' chɨtda; gio ba' gu Absalom tu' jix koi bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Dabii jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ mi'x juu'ñ gu oidha' bɨx gu suudai' gu jodai' jajannulhi'ñ mi'p vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonadab gu mar gu Simea xibhɨk gu Dabii; gio ba' cham gu takarui' gu Jawatan jix duñia' jix koi bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu oi'ñga'n gu Amnoon jix koi; na gu' gu chin gu Absalom ka't gu ñi'ook dɨr gu tanoolh gu Amnoon jix duñia' gu Tamar gu ja'tkam.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jano' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu i'ii'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' koko'kam; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Amnoon jix koi.

Jano' ba' gu Absalom jix duñia'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui gu takarui' ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu suudai' jix jai' gu ja'tkam gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonadab gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' jupaabkamu'n; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu duukam tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' tɨɨtɨs gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio gu gɨ'kora' bɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Gu' gu' gu Absalom jix duñia' ka't gu Talmai gu mar gu Amiud gu gɨ'kora' gu Gessur; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ux gu mar bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Absalom jix duñia' ka't gu Gessur juruuñ vaik gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Absalom; na gu' tu' ka't gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Amnoon ka't jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix maati' gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ux gu Absalom.

Ba' jix aa' bhañ gu Joab gu Tekoa jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ jix maat; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug cham tu' maa'n bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ va'k tu' na ja'p gu u'vɨ tu' jix jai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu kutun jix koi.
Jano' ba' baakɨk gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx dhi'; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Joab gu ñi'ook gu chin.
Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu Tekoa gu gɨ'kora' gu takarui' gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui jix duu tu jiim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' dodhia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu'r jix duñia' gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu chio'ñ jix koi.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam na tu juan ga'ra' gook gu ma'nkam gook gu suudai' yooxi'; gio ba' cham dhaibu gu oi'ñga'n naaka'n maa'n jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu bhóogɨt tu' jix duñia' bhaan ja'tkam na tu juan bham; gio ba' kapbhai' mu'aa xibhɨk na ba' jix duu koi gu ux gu oidha' xibhɨk mu'aa gu takarui' gio bi'ya'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu takarui' tu' jix duñia' cham mi'x dhaas gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu chuukug bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu chuukug gu vaak tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ gu Tekoa gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug tu' na cham jir bhai' ka't bhaan tu' bhaan gu vaak gu taat; gu' gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios cham mi'x dhaas mia'n gu ɨ'ɨr gu jodai' gu tanoolh bɨɨx cham tu' duu gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chuukug tu' gu bhóogɨt mo'o gu mar gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ; na gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' gu jodai' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios a'gi'ñchu' gu gɨ'kora' dhi' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook na gu' gu gɨ'kora' cham gu ux gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.

Na gu' na gu' tɨɨda' jix koi gu'ch na ja'p gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu oidha' cham jɨ'xdha' gu bhóogɨt jix duu; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu i'ii'ñ cham ka't gu chuukug.

Na gu' tu' tɨbiap jano' na ba' a'ga dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan na gu' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook ɨɨbhi'ñ; gu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook jano' gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' gu kutun jix duñia' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu takarui'.
Na gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt na ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu novɨ gu chio'ñ gu suudai' tu' gu mar bɨɨma'n gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ja'tkam na tu juan tu ñi'ook; na ka't jano' gu suudai' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ba' gu suudai'; na gu' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix kai jix bhai' cham bhai'; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ cham gu bhóogɨt cham tu' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ jix aa'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham tu' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Joab bɨndak bɨx dhi' tu'x gu u'vɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' o'nsop bɨx gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu duukam gu Joab jix aa'ñdhix jix dhaas gu chin ja'tkam na tu juan bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' na jix uam duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Joab tu duukam tu' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Jawatan jix bhai'x jurtu'nka' matda' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix maati' cham tu'x jai'ch gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joab; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Absalom.

Ba' jix aa' gu Joab o'lhia'n gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui jix duu tu jiim mi' dhɨr jix bhai' aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu duukam gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Joab ka't gu Gessur jix duñia' gu Absalom gu Jerusalem.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak cham gu chuukug gu vupui; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Absalom gu vaak cham jix ñi' gu vupui gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' cham ka't bɨx gu Israeel gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Absalom gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dɨr gu vaas tɨɨt bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug cham ka't gu jodai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook oidha' tas jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mo'o gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Absalom vaik gu ma'nkam mar u'vɨ jup tɨɨt gu Tamar ka't gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' juruuñ gu Absalom gu ux gu ñi'ook gook gu takarui' gu Jerusalem cham jix ñi' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Absalom gu ux gu Joab na ba' tɨip gu gɨ'kora'; gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n jix ai; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ux bhañ gu ux gookim jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix ai.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu duukam; gio ba' xoi'kam gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Joab ju'ñdharan pai' juraa'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu tai; jano' ba' tu duukam gu Absalom jix duñia' gu tai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu ux gu jodai' gu Joab suudai' u'va gu Absalom gu vaak; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tai tu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Absalom jix aa' gu vaak; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu' bham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Gessur tutkɨ mai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu chuukug tu' jano' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' uañi'ñ gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jix duu suudai' u'va gu Joab gu gɨ'kora' maachim; gio ba' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Absalom suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu vupui gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Absalom gu bhóogɨt kavaayo mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu jodai' vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Absalom gu xibh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob; gio ba' no'x ga'ra' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Absalom tɨɨt chɨtda; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n kiicham gu chuukug tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu duukam bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Absalom chɨtda; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' chɨtda gu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka jix dhaas gu ux jir bɨx bhai' gu oidha' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n tu' bɨx namki' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu' gu chuukug bɨx bhai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' jix duñia' na ba' gu ux gu tanoolh gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Absalom gu i'ii'ñ gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu maa'nkar oo'm gu takarui' ka't gu Absalom gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ebroon gu ñi'ook gu tasi' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' tu duukam gu tasi' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Gessur gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jerusalem tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix búup ka't gu ebroon.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook bhañ gu Absalom gu ñi'ook gu ux bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bham; na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu Absalom gu ñi'ook gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx gu Absalom gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ gu Jerusalem gu ux koi'cham jix duñia' gu ja'tkam cham maachim cham tu'.

Jano' ba' gio bhañ gu Absalom gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu Gilonita gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu Gilo kiicham gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' makgɨrxi'ñdha'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n suudai' u'va gu suudai' jix gɨ' gu chuukug gu jodai' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu Israeel tu' bhaan gu Absalom.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx tu duukam mi'p bɨɨx gu Jerusalem; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu chuukug jix duu cham ka't gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' cham bhai' bhaan no'ch gu oi'ñga'n kiicham gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gui'p gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba' jix buus bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx gu u'vɨ na ba' nukadham gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu takarui' gu ñi'ook pai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx gu Kereteos gu Peleteos; gio ba' bɨx gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' tɨbiap tɨɨt dɨr gu Gat jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ittai gu chuukug; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu' gio bɨɨx no'ch gu bhóogɨt tu' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu' gu chuukug ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gio pai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu takarui' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ pai' na ba' tu' bɨɨx no'ch tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' ka't xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Ittai gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ba' koi'm na ba' gu oidha' pai' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gio tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Ittai; gio ba' gu kutun gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Ittai gu chuukug bɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨx ja'tkam vaak.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam bhi'ñbak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gio gu chuukug gu Sadok bɨɨx bɨx gu Lebitas jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu Abiatar mi' dhɨr ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak kiicham bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sadok; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios kiicham; na tu' gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui'; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu oi'ñga'n tu' xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' cham gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhai'x i'ii'ñ kiicham; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gook gu ma'nkam gu mar gu Aimaas gu Jonataan gu mar gu Abiatar.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' vaak ja'tkam oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix maa aa'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar suulh kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ joi'ndam gu suudai' mo'o iiñat tɨɨt jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gio bɨx gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak jix bhaan dhaas maa'n mo'o jix tɨ'ɨ joi'ndam na ja'p jix tɨ'ɨ.

Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; jano' ba' gu takarui' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ux gu kavɨk na ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu usai gu Arakîta jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bhaan mo'o.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ka' gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' tu' gu jodai' kiicham gu chuukug gu Absalom; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duñia' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr na ja'p bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' tu duukam gu taat jix duñia' jano' tu duukam gu oi'ñga'n jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' cham no'm bɨndak gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ux gu jodai' bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' maa'n aa'ñdham gu i'ii'ñ gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx gook gu ma'nkam gu Aimaas gu Sadok gu Jonataan gu Abiatar; gio ba' gu ux gu novɨ gu ñi'ook aa'ñdham bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu usai gu i'ii'ñ gu Dabii kiicham; gio ba' gu Absalom chɨbiapui gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ux gu kavɨk gu suudai' gu Siba jix duñia' gu Mepi-boset busaak gu takarui' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siba; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Siba jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ba' ja'tkam vaak gu gɨ'kora' jix tɨ'ɨ; jano' ba' gu takarui' na ba' gu suudai' jugi; gio ba' suudai' u'va na ba' gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' duukat gu mar gu Jawatan gu Siba jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu Jerusalem na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siba; gio ba' gu suudai' ka't gu oi'ñga'n bɨx juraa'n gu Mepi-boset; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Siba gu jodai'; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tu' nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm gu Baurim; gio ba' gu suudai' busaak maa'n ja'tkam vaak gu vaak gu Sauul jup tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Gera; mi' dhɨr busaak gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ gu jodai bhaan gu Dabii bhaan bɨx tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk mi'p kɨɨ'n gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' chɨtda gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix buus gu chio'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu kutun bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu vaak gu Sauul pai' tu' gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu mar gu Absalom; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n tu' na cham jir bhai' na gu' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abisai gu mar gu maa'nkar gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt dhi' gagai' jix koi gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' soi'ñ mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook gu jodai' mo'o.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; na gu' gu Kuee no'ñ tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr chɨkka gu chuukug; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abisai bɨx tu duukam; gio ba' gu suudai' gu mar tu' gu ñi'ook ba'k gu takarui' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n jano' gu mar gu Benjamiin tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu kutun jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' maa'n gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ux gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk vupui bhaan jiim gu jodai' jix duñia' gu jodai vupui bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oo'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Absalom bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel baap gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' na ja'p gu usai gu Arakîta gu i'ii'ñ gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook gu Absalom gu usai; gio ba' gu tai gu gɨ'kora' gu tai gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Absalom gu jodai'; gio ba' dhi' gu bhóogɨt na ba' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu ux gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu usai jix aa' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr va'k gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' tu' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' chɨkka ka't tu' tu juan cham gu mar na ja'p jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu taat jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Absalom gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda'.

Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ba'k gu u'vɨ gu taat mi'x dhaas na ba' nukadham gu vaak; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu taat jix duñia' gu noobh bɨx bɨndak.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix dhaas vaak zel gu Absalom bhaan gu tasi' chɨbiapui gu Absalom gu u'vɨ gu taat gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu kutun jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh ka't na ja'p tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' ka't gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu Dabii na ja'p bɨɨx gu Absalom.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Absalom; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug jano' gu kutun jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu Dabii dhi' gu tukaa'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' bhaan na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu takarui' gu noobh; gio ba' gu jodai' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' bɨx gu ja'tkam tu'; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' xoi'kam gu Absalom bɨx daraa gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Absalom; gio ba' mɨmɨim gio jano' gu usai gu Arakîta na ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu usai suudai' u'va gu Absalom bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt cham tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu usai gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kutun tu' jix maa dhi' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n cham jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai'; na pai' dhuuk tu' ñɨidhat gu taat gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu takarui' na ja'p gu duukam yooxi' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu taat gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham cham gu oi'ñga'n gu tukaa' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ux jano' gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook jumpa'n pai'; gio ba' tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu suudai' dhɨt gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu takarui' gu Absalom tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk gu i'ii'ñ ka't na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ maavɨt cham jix duñia'; na gu' bɨx gu Israeel gu maa'nkar gu taat gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' bɨx gu Israeel gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug pai' gu bhóogɨt bakia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan na ja'p na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' tu' maa'n mi'x dhaas bɨx bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook kiicham bɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr kiicham gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Absalom bɨx gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' gu kutun gu usai gu Arakîta tutkɨ gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu suudai' gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' jix ai cham bhai' bhaan gu Absalom.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu jodai' gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu tanoolh; na gu' cham maa'n gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar na gu' gu mar gu gɨ'kora' jix koi.
