Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug tu duukam tu' gu suudai'; na gu' ka't tu duukam tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook buur jix tɨ'ɨ tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu duukam jix bhai'x.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu vupui xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu vaak gu taat ka't gu suudai' koi'm vupui bhaan gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix dhaas tu duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi'cham meesa; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu tanoolh tu' gu Siba gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mepi-boset gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu bhóogɨt bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gio gu Barsillai gu duukam jix dhaav gu Rogelim jix duñia' gu Jordaan bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' na ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Barsillai gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu takarui' ka't jix maa gu duukam gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Maanaim na gu' ka't gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Barsillai; gio ba' gu takarui' gu chuukug tu' gu suudai' jugi gu chuukug gu Jerusalem.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Barsillai gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na ba' tu' jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu takarui' tu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' cham bhai'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' jano' tu duukam jugi gu jodai' tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt tu duukam gu suudai' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu duukam gu jodai' gu Jordaan bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' soi'ñ mi'x dhaas gu bhóogɨt tu duukam gu jodai' kiicham ju'ñdharan tukga'n gu taat gu naan; gio ba' gu suudai' tu duukam gu Kimam; na gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu jiim xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu Kimam tu' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx na ja'p xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr bɨx tu' gu takarui' tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Barsillai jix bhai' aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Gilgal bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Kimam; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Judaa bɨɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora' gui'p; gio ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' baabuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam vaak bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Dabii bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa tu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel; na gu' gu gɨ'kora' chulhiiñdha' jir bɨx bhai'; gu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' no'ch jugi gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' dho'ñchidhak gu kutun gu duukam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gui'p gu Judaa; gio ba' no'ch tañia' gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu jodai' cham a'aixkam no'ch maa'n gu bhóogɨt chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x jup tɨɨt gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin jix duñia' gu duukam; gio ba' cham tañia' no'ch baasɨ'n gu Dabii tu' gu maa'nkar gu mar gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel maa'n dhi'.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu Dabii bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel oi'ñchu' gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri; gu' gu Judaa jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' dɨr gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu vaak gu Jerusalem jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx gu u'vɨ ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim na ba' nukadham gu vaak jix dhaas gu vaak jix nukadham jix maa jugi; gu' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n chɨbiapui gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm jix koko' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Amasa; gio ba' gu Juuntame gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa na ba' gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu o'o.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Amasa gu oi'ñga'n gu Judaa; gu' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' nɨi'ñchudat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abisai; gio ba' gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri jix duñia' jano' gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai' gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ tu' tu duukam gu Jawatan tu' bhaan cham ka't gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' moor gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ gu Joab gu Kereteos gu Peleteos bɨx jix kavɨk; gio ba' moor gu Jerusalem na ba' tu' bhaan gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri.

Jano' ba' kua' mia'n jix gɨ' jodai kavɨk gu kutun jix buus gu Amasa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jano' xoi'kam kutun gu Joab ga'ra' daam ka't gu jodai' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ux na ja'p jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joab gu Amasa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ xibhɨk gu chuukug jix bhɨɨ gu Joab bɨɨx kɨɨ'n gu chuukug gu Amasa na ba' gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Amasa cham jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Joab gu novɨ ga'ra' naaka'n gu ux bɨɨx gu jodai' o'o ja'aa ba'k gu ux gu oidha' jix duñia' jix koi cham nukadham gook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu Joab xibhɨk gu Abisai jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu suudai' gu Joab gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan bham; gio ba' no'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Joab gu Dabii gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Joab.

Jano' ba' gu Amasa ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt; na gu' ñɨi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix ai'chdhix gu Amasa gu bhóogɨt yooxi' jix duñia' bhaan kutun na gu' gu chuukug bɨx aajidha' gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨx oi'ñchu' gu Joab na ba' tu' bhaan gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu Abel gu Bet-maakâ bɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' jum daa'ñ bhiadat gio.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs jix duñia' gu Abel gu bhóogɨt jix dhaas gu duukam bhaan kiicham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx gu Joab jix duñia' gu ux gu o'o vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook jix maa jiiñak kiicham bham; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu Joab gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x na ba' tu' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu chuukug tu' gu Joab jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia'; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' ñiokda' bham; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu tas ñiokda' bham; na tu ñi'ook gu Abel; jano' ba' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' cham tu' duu kiicham gu naan gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa' bham; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham; gu' gu chio'ñ gu kavɨk gu Epraim mɨmɨim gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri tu' jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr kapbhai' gu chuukug gu suudai' tu jiim kiicham; jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix aa' gu vaak; gio ba' gu suudai' mo'o tu' ka't mi'x juu'ñ dɨr gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx matda'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mo'o gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri jix duñia' gu Joab; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu duukam gu ñi'ook kiicham maa'n dhi'; jano' ba' gu Joab jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Na ba' jix duñia' gu Joab bhaan bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada bhaan gu Kereteos gu Peleteos.
Jano' ba' gu Adoram bhaan bopxi'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Aillud gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Seba gu o'o; gio ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr daak gu jodai' ka't gu kutun gɨ'kora' ja'tkam mia'n gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Seba gu o'o; gio ba' gu Sadok gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu Ira gu Jaireo ka't gu kutun gɨ'kora' ja'tkam mia'n gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Dabii ka't bhiogi' gu ux vaik gu takarui' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu Sauul gu ux mii' dhɨr gu vaak gu ɨ'ɨr; na gu' jix duñia' gu jodai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jup tɨɨt gu jodai'; gio ba' gu jodai' cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Amorreos gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Sauul ka't gu bhóogɨt kooda' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Judaa; jano' ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham tañia' no'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan jix toja jodai tu' bhaan jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu Sauul bɨɨx gu vaak; mi' dhɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu chio'ñ gu Israeel; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix duñia' bhaan no'ch na ba' gu takarui' cham mi'x dhaas cham tu' no'ch bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug kɨɨv gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam na ba' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu Sauul gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul.

Gu' gu' jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' gook gu ma'nkam gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu chuukug ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Sauul maachim gu Armoni gu Mepi-boset; gio ba' jixchamaam gu ma'nkam gu jodai' mar u'vɨ gu Sauul ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Adriel gu mar gu Barsillai gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' do'ñcho gu noobh gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix koko' tɨtda:―Aañ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam kɨɨv jix bɨɨx duu koko'kam gu ñi'ook oraa' dharka' gu tanoolh gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu chuukug gu ux jix duñia' bhaan gu jodai' na jix uam dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' bhaan gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' cham mi'x dhaas matgɨm gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu tanoolh tu' gu vaakax yooxi' gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu chuukug gu u'vɨ gu Sauul.

Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't jix bhɨɨ o'oo gu Sauul o'oo gu Jonataan gu mar gu chichio'ñ gu Jabes gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt ɨrban gu Bet-san pai' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu Pilisteos na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Pilisteos gu Sauul gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' o'oo gu Sauul o'oo gu Jonataan gu mar; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gio o'oo gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook o'oo gu Sauul gu mar gu Jonataan gu oidha' gu Benjamiin gu Sela tukga'n gu Kis gu taat; gio ba' jix duu bɨx gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix aa'ñdhix; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu chuukug bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel jix dhaav gu Dabii tu duukam bɨɨx gu ux bɨɨx gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Isbi-benob ka't gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu jodai' ka't vaik gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam ga'ra' gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu kuchii jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii.

Gu' gu' gu Abisai gu mar gu maa'nkar jix duñia' naaka'n gu Pilisteo jix duñia'; gio ba' jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Dabii gu ñi'ook bham; na gu' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu jodai' bɨɨx no'ch gu chuukug na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gookim bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't mi' dhɨr gu Gob bhaan gu Pilisteos; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Sibekâi gu usatita naaka'n gu Sap ka't gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu Gob bhaan gu Pilisteos gu Elanan gu mar gu Jaare-oregim gu Bet-leem naaka'n gu Goliat gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt ka't na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Gat pai' ka't gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' jix duñia' ga'ra' gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu noobh gu kutun tɨɨt maakob bɨx; gio ba' gio ka't gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sima xibhɨk gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam maakobh gu suudai' maaxir gu ñi'ook gu Gat ia'rɨ gu ux gu novɨ gu Dabii gu ux gu novɨ tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dhi' gu duukam gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu takarui' gu novɨ bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ gu Sauul.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jodai kavɨk gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tulhiiñdha' gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr boosolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios suuska'n gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' obhɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n koi'm gu jodai' tu' na cham jir bhai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' gu vaak koi'm.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix kai gu ñi'ook dɨr vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu ñi'ook maatɨt.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu jodai' gu tɨkɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' na gu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ kuubh gu takarui' gu chin gu tai jix duñia' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr jix dhaav; gio ba' gu tukgam bɨtaa'n tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook da'a; gio ba' jix ñi'ñ bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tukgam xikoolh ba'r; gio ba' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tɨbaa'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' dɨr gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook jix maa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu jodai' oipichu' jix bɨɨx duu gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ daak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu novɨ jix bhai'x jix duñia' jix buusñi gu takarui' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix kavɨk obhɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix kavɨk tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tanoolh jix duñia'; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu kutun; na gu' jix duñia' na gu' jix dhaas aagak tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu kutun gu noobh jix maa gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' na gu' tu' nukadham gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chuukug jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' vupui bhaan tu' no'ñ bɨx gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' cham gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx bhai' na ba' bɨɨx nukadham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai' jurtu'nka' gu kutun vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix bhai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx bhai' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' na jix bhai' gu chuukug na ba' bɨɨx gu' bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ; gu' gu vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' tu jiim.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tasi' gu tukgam.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n chugi'ñ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu ux tɨɨt na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu ñi'ook gu noobh na ba' gu bhóogɨt jix maa bɨɨx gu novɨ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' chɨɨdak gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tulhiiñdha' jix duñia' tu' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n bɨtaa'n tu' na ba' cham gu chuukug kɨkbok.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' obhɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' cham gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham jix búup; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨtaa'n tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu kavɨk na ba' gu chuukug gu takarui' bɨtaa'n tu' bhaan tu' jix búup.
Jano' ba' tu' chɨɨdak gu suudai' obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu jodai'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu' cham jix aa'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' na ja'p oo' gu oidha'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' nukadham na ba' jum duu mo'o chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam cham gu suudai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu'; gio ba' tɨiñ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tai gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam dodhia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chuukug gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n tu'.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix buusñi jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix búup bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu chio'ñ tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu chuukug tulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu mar gu Isaii mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu ux tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' nɨɨn.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu Israeel; gio ba' aapi' gu chichio'ñ ka't jir bhai' aapi' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na ja'p gu tasi' gu xibh na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu tas gu xibh cham tɨbaa'ñ; na pai' dhuuk gu vaas gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr dhuuk.

Jano' ba' cham gu vaak na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu chuukug jix duñia' bɨx tu'x ka't nukadham; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam bɨx dhi' tulhiiñdha' bɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't bɨx na ja'p jo'ii' gu chuukug soo'mchulhdhak jix bhɨɨ bɨɨx gu novɨ.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' kuichdha' gu chuukug jix kavɨk jodai gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' pai'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Takmonita jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ux gu suudai' jix duñia' bua' bhaan gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr gu ux gu Eleasar gu mar gu Dodo gu Aoi ka't vaik jix kavɨk mi'p bɨɨx gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Pilisteos gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix tɨ'ɨ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' dhi' kɨkbo naaka'n gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu novɨ jix duñia' gu chuukug gu kuchii; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix duu tulhiiñdha'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ux ka't gu Samma gu mar gu Age gu Araita; na gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos gu bhóogɨt ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' jix duñia' naaka'n gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' vaik gu ñi'ook jix dhaav tɨɨtɨs gu ñi'ook oraa' gu Dabii jumpa'n gu Adullam; gio ba' yooxi' gu Pilisteos ka't gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jano' ba' ka't gu kavɨk gu takarui' gu Pilisteos ka't gu Bet-leem.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka gu takarui' i'i gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu Bet-leem ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' vaik jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu ux yooxi' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu Bet-leem ka't ki'ñgob; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ aichdhak gu Dabii; gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n i'i gu ñi'ook ja'aa gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n dhi'; gio ba' i'i tu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' cham gu oi'ñga'n i'i; mi' dhɨr vaik jix kavɨk jix duu dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu Abisai xibhɨk gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam vaik; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bhaan vaik jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik.
Jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook vaik maa'n; gu' cham jix duñia' vaik dharka'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' gu mar gu chio'ñ gu takarui' jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Kabseel; gio ba' dhi' naaka'n gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moab; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav naaka'n maavɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jabook.

Jano' ba' gio naaka'n gu Egipkio gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' dhi'; gio ba' ga'ra' gu Egipkio gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ; gu' jix dhaav bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Egipkio gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ mu'aa bɨɨx gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu Benaiia gu mar gu suudai' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gu' cham jix duñia' vaik dharka'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Asael xibhɨk gu Joab ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Elaanan gu mar gu Dodo gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu Samma gu arodi gu Elika gu arodi.
Jano' ba' gu eles gu Palti gu ira gu mar gu takarui' gu Tekoa.
Jano' ba' gu Abieser gu Anatot gu Mebunnai gu usa.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ao gu Maarai gu Netopat.
Jano' ba' gu elek gu mar gu Baana gu Netopat gu Ittai gu mar gu Ribai gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu Piratonita gu iddai gu jodai' gu Gaas.
Jano' ba' gu Abi-albon gu Arbat gu Asmabet gu Barum.
Jano' ba' gu Eliaba gu Saalboon gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Jasseen.
Jano' ba' gu Samma gu Arar gu Aiam gu mar gu Sarar gu Arar.
Jano' ba' gu Elipelet gu mar gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Maakâti; gio ba' gu Eliam gu mar gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu esrai gu Karmelo gu takarui' gu Arbi.
Jano' ba' gu Igeal gu mar gu Nataan gu Soba gu Bani gu Gadi.
Jano' ba' gu Selek gu Ammoon gu Naarai gu Beerot kutun kavɨk gu Joab gu mar gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu Ira gu Itri gu Gareb gu Itri.
Jano' ba' gu Uriia gu takarui'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios jix duu bhaan gu Israeel jix duñia' gu Dabii bhaan tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Israeel gu Judaa.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joab gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ga'ra' baidhak; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba jix duñia' gu ja'tkam na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook mui'kim gu jodai' na ja'p gu chuukug gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; gu' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' dhi' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Joab gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix buus gu Joab bɨɨx gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' na ba' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu Jordaan jix duñia' gu Aroer gu novɨ tu jiim kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu Gad ju'ñdharan gu Jaser.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Dan-jaaan xikoolh gu Sidoon.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu kavɨk gu Tiro bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook gu Kananeos; gio ba' moor saagi'ñ gu Judaa gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr a'lhiok gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu oidha' suulh gu Jerusalem gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook masaa'n gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu Joab jix maa jix duñia' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Israeel gu chuukug jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Yo uañi'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook dhi'; na gu' gu' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu suudai' uañi'ñ tu duukam na gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ux gu xibh na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Gad jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Dabii bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr vaik tu'x tu' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu' gu chuukug tu' gu oi'ñga'n.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Gad gu Dabii jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt kɨɨv gu takarui' bhiogi' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik masaa'n vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n vaik gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ñi'ook jano' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Gad; gio ba' jix gɨ' jix duñia' dhi'; na gu' soi'ñ jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu jodai' mumua'da' cham jix duñia' tu' gu noobh gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat; gio ba' jix koko' gu ja'tkam dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba gu vaak jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p nobii'ñ jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu Jerusalem na ba' cham tu' duu gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' mii' dhɨr cham bhai' nobii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' jano'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ; jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan ka't gu Arauna gu Jebuseo.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Yo gu bhóogɨt tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' na cham jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duu dhi' kakneer jix duñia' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' bhaan gu vaak gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gad suudai' u'va gu Dabii mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu vupui jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Arauna gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Dabii jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Gad gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' tɨɨgɨk gu Arauna jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gamai' jano' ba' gu Arauna jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Arauna; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam gu Dabii jix aa'; na ba' jugi tu' ka't na ba' gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix koi gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Arauna gu Dabii; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu chuukug gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu vaakax na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan; jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu takarui' gu vaakax na ba' gu u'u.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix maa na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Arauna gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Arauna gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu ux u'uuk tu' jugi; na gu' cham gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ux cham tu'; jano' ba' gu Dabii jugi ka't gu vaakax gu ux mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bɨɨx gu oidha' jix utu'ñ gu ux gu Israeel.
